## Goal

One or two sentences: what exists when this is done.

## Context

Where this runs (host / VM / cluster), what it depends on, and the files it touches.

## Steps

Ordered, specific, and small. Anything a human must do by hand is marked **HUMAN**.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] ...
- [ ] CI is green on the pull request

## Evidence to commit

- `evidence/NN-topic.md` sections: ...
- `agents/reports/...` (if an agent report is expected)

## Out of scope

What this task must not touch.
